about: Pool targets per bundle (plans/12, D-53): approved questions in total and per difficulty (scale of app/data/age-groups.json). Per-category shares are derived, not stored.

batch_health.about: Batch health thresholds (plan 15, pm decision 13, D-55): metric of health.py → min/max; a ✗ in the last done batch stops the next `qgen batch` until `qgen health ack`. «needs_work: each problem» applies to every problem without its own key.

quality.about: Quality bar per batch (plan 16, pm decision 2): human spot-check size and min. share where the human agrees with the LLM review, in each of the last two batches. Also the Steam release bar per batch/back-audit slice (D-79, pm decision 15).
